input.sha256_scope: Concatenation of the fifteen raw C-order input byte arrays in capture document order.
input.provenance: Self-authored in-memory BGR uint8 values emitted by tools/capture_crop_oracle.py.

expected.sha256_scope: Concatenation of the fifteen raw C-order output byte arrays in capture document order.

geometry_oracle.sha256_scope: All seventy-five non-comment CSV rows, generated in document order from the fifteen self-authored BGR crop cases.
geometry_oracle.provenance: OpenCV 5.0.0 cv2.getPerspectiveTransform with destination/source order reversed, then cv2.perspectiveTransform at four destination boundaries and one interior coordinate per case.

limitations: This is an exact regression fixture only for its fifteen self-authored BGR cases and recorded capture environment.
It does not establish image-decoder, RGB/BGR conversion, alpha, orientation, detector, recognizer, model, or end-to-end OCR compatibility.
It does not establish universal or upstream-environment OpenCV INTER_CUBIC bit equivalence.
